newsitem.title: USA: Gelman, Memtec set merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Gelman, Memtec set merger pact.

text.p: Memtec Ltd and Gelman Sciences Inc said Friday they signed a definitive merger agreement for their previously announced stock-swap deal.

Ann Arbor-based Gelman and Memtec of Windsor, Australia, announced an agreement in principal in July. Under the agreement, Gelman common holders will receive 1.05 Memtec American Depository Shares for each outstanding Gelman share.
If the average closing price of Memtec depository shares falls below $30 each, Gelman may terminate the deal.
The deal is expected to close before the end of 1996, and is still subject to approval of shareholders of both companies. It is not expected to be dilutive to Memtec's earnings per share.
Once approved, Gelman, which makes filtration products for the medical and research industries, will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Memtec.
